rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual choice when you mean keeping an eye on people or a task.

example.english: Can you supervise the children while I go get some water?
example.traditional: 你幫我睇住啲細路，我去買杯水。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 di1 sai3 lou6 ngo5 heoi3 maai5 bui1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing formal oversight or directing the work of a group or organization.

example.english: The manager will supervise the whole project to make sure everything goes according to plan.
example.traditional: 經理會監督成個工程，確保一切按計劃進行。
example.jyutping: ging1 lei5 wui5 gaam1 duk1 seng4 go3 gung1 cing4 kok3 bou2 jat1 cai3 on3 gai3 waak6 zeon3 hang4
